 Harris County District Court
 Cause No. 2024-CV-0018
 Lisa Mcdaniel, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Defendant's Original Answer
Date:
8-10-24
Counsel for defendant:
Richard Marshall, Ashford & Lyle LLP
Defendant, for its answer to Plaintiff's Original Petition, generally denies each and every allegation contained therein
and demands strict proof thereof as required by the Texas Rules of Civil Procedure. Pursuant to Rule 92, Defendant
further asserts the following affirmative defenses.
First, Plaintiff's own negligence caused or contributed to the collision. Plaintiff failed to keep a proper lookout, failed to
confirm that the adjacent lane was clear before moving, and failed to yield the right of way as required when cahnging
lanes. Under Chapter 33 of the Texas Ciivl Practice and Remedies Code, any recovery must be reduced by the
percentage of responsibility attributable to Plaintiff.
Second, the injuries and damages claimed were not proximately caused by the subject collision. Plaintiff's alleged
conditions may be attributable to preexisting or unrelated medical conditions, or to subsequent events, and Defendant
is not liable for those.
Third, Plaintiff has fialed to mitigate damages. Plaintiff did not follow reasonable medical advice or undertake
reasonable steps to limit the claimed losses, and any recovery must be barred or reduced accordingly.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
